cohort: 2,685 children whose maternal age at the time of birth was between 18 and 35 years
finding: Both elective and non-elective cesarean delivery were associated with an increased risk of accelerated weight gain in early childhood.
mod_finding: Both elective and non-elective Cesarean delivery were associated with the 'increasing from moderate to high' and 'increasing from low to high' BMI z-score trajectory patterns compared to vaginal delivery.
